answer: By binding each identity to a hardware-rooted clock attestation, an agent economy can require that every new node present a fresh, causally ordered timestamp signed at a unique physical knoll of trust, preventing a single host from minting a plume of phantom peers. Peers cross-validate these attestations against Byzantine skew bounds, so a jade badge of identity only. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
